## Services

- AI & Smart Automation: custom AI assistants for 24/7 customer service, workflow automation, software integrations
- Websites: high-performance custom websites built to convert
- Mobile Apps: native and cross-platform iOS/Android development, App Store deployment
- Desktop Software: custom Windows, Mac, and cross-platform desktop applications
- Data & Analytics: data pipelines, sales/customer/operations analytics, secure database backups
- Dashboards: real-time KPI dashboards for sales, operations, and finance
- Cloud Infrastructure: migration and architecture on AWS and Google Cloud, auto-scaling, disaster recovery
- Networking: network design, VPN/firewall setup, security hardening, ongoing support
- Cybersecurity: vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security audits, incident response
- Hardware: workstation and server procurement, setup, troubleshooting, device configuration

3. Build with regular updates and feedback loops
4. Launch with ongoing 24/7 support
